title: Landing page
caption: A calm, patient-first front door: what the platform offers, who it is for, and one click to sign in or register.

title: Sign in
caption: Email or user ID with password; accounts with two-factor enabled are asked for a one-time code.

title: Interface in Bengali
caption: The UI is translated per user. Strings come from the i18n service, pre-translated so it also works offline.

title: Patient registration
caption: Self-service sign-up with validation; a verification code is sent before the account unlocks.

title: Doctor onboarding
caption: Doctors submit qualifications, certifications and license details; an administrator approves the account before first use.

title: Password recovery
caption: OTP-based reset flow with a resend timer.

title: Local mailbox
caption: Offline stand-in for email, SMS and push providers: every message the platform sends is captured and shown here, OTP codes highlighted.

title: Medicine library
caption: Searchable, sortable catalogue with expiry filters, 40 medicines with warnings and adverse effects.

title: Medicine details
caption: Classification, strength, warnings, adverse effects and manufacturer in one view.

title: Hospital equipment
caption: Diagnostic and treatment equipment with availability and costing, bookable ahead of time.

title: Equipment details
caption: Use cases, technical details, warnings and costing.

title: Unified search
caption: One query fans out to patients, doctors, medicines, appointments and community posts through the help-desk service.

title: Admin dashboard
caption: Walk-in appointments, doctor rooms, user management and statistics behind one tabbed console.

title: Room allocation
caption: Assign every doctor a consultation room; patients see the room on their appointment.

title: Doctor management
caption: Approve, deactivate or review doctors; new doctors stay inactive until an administrator verifies them.

title: Patient management
caption: Browse patients, open their health data and manage account status.

title: Operational statistics
caption: Appointment volume per day, shift distribution and consultation types, computed in the appointment service.

title: Walk-in booking
caption: The front desk books in-person visits for unregistered patients.

title: Create administrator
caption: Administrators are created by existing administrators only.

title: Add a medicine
caption: Full pharmacological record with photo upload to the local file service.

title: Add equipment
caption: Equipment records with use cases, warnings and pricing.

title: Community moderation
caption: Admins can publish announcements and FAQs and remove any post.

title: Notification and language settings
caption: Per-user channel preferences (email, SMS, push), do-not-disturb and interface language.

title: Doctor dashboard
caption: Today's queue: upcoming in-person and telemedicine consultations with join-call buttons, and completed visits.

title: Schedule management
caption: Pick a day, choose in-person, telemedicine or off for each shift and set the capacity per slot.

title: Public doctor profile
caption: Bio, qualifications, certifications, availability for the next days and verified patient reviews.

title: Edit profile
caption: Doctors maintain their own bio, specialization and credentials.

title: Write a treatment record
caption: Structured treatment notes that feed the clinical decision support engine.

title: Patient directory
caption: Doctors can open any patient's health profile and history.

title: Patient record with AI analysis
caption: Health data, treatment history and the AI-assisted analysis in one place.

title: Articles and first aid
caption: Doctors publish articles and first-aid guides for the whole community.

title: Telemedicine call
caption: Peer-to-peer WebRTC video room, access verified against the appointment window. Works with no cloud video service.

title: Patient dashboard
caption: Upcoming and completed appointments with room numbers, plus wellness challenges.

title: Wellness challenges
caption: Gamified goals set by administrators; patients log daily scores and earn badges.

title: Find a doctor
caption: Filter 30 specializations, see experience, treatments and availability at a glance.

title: Pick a slot
caption: Choose a day within the next ten days and a morning, afternoon or evening slot, with live capacity and delay information.

title: Health profile
caption: Vitals, allergies, lifestyle flags, treatments and achievements in one profile.

title: AI health analysis
caption: A three-part report on the treatment history, comparable anonymised cases and what to do next. Generated on the platform's own server.

title: Edit health profile
caption: Update vitals, allergies and contact info, with photo upload.

title: Community feed
caption: Status posts, doctor-written articles, first-aid guides and FAQs, with reactions and comments.

title: Post and discussion
caption: Threaded comments with doctor replies, and one-click translation of any post.

title: Notifications
caption: Appointment reminders, community activity and site announcements, with unread tracking.

title: Settings
caption: Choose notification channels and the interface language.

title: Responsive on mobile
caption: The same dashboard on a phone-sized screen.

title: Mobile sign-in
caption: Sign-in on a small screen.

title: Service registry
caption: Spring Cloud Eureka showing the microservices registered and healthy.
